lines: This is the real Codeville app. It checks Git, Claude Code and Node, then you open your project.
An analysis agent reads it: the stack, the layers, every feature, and how they connect.
Your prompts, made visual. Each feature is a district, and every file is a block.
Pick a file, and the town shows where it lives. Open it right in the editor.
Links show how the parts talk to each other.
Now, just prompt. Ask Claude Code for a wishlist feature...
and watch every file it writes land in your project, live, with its tests.
Run the tests, and a shopper walks every case.
It stops at the broken one, and tells you what to fix next.
So ask Claude to fix it. All eight tests pass.
Then ship it. Stage, commit and push, in one click.
And the fun part. Turn on your camera, and your code becomes a hologram, like Tony Stark's lab.
Spread two hands to zoom, make a fist to hold, and pinch twice to reset.
Codeville. Vibe code. See it build.
